scope: A genuine measure on the coordinate unit sphere and scalar kernel action on constants, linear modes, and trace-free quadratics; not the all-degree spherical-harmonic/Funk-Hecke theorem.
measure_semantics: sigmaChart is Measure.map of the CAS16 Cartesian chart from chartMeasure, the product of Lebesgue-comap subtype interval measures. It is an explicit positive measure on S2, not identified with Mathlib volume.toSphere or called canonical dOmega.
target_theorem_signatures: G12CFiniteChart.chart_monomial_bridge (a b c : Nat) : (1 / (4 * Real.pi)) * (∫ u : S2, u.1 0 ^ a * u.1 1 ^ b * u.1 2 ^ c ∂sigmaChart) = CAS16C03.sphereMean a b c

G12CFiniteChart.scatter_affine_traceless_quadratic (c : Real) (b : Vec3) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) Real) (htrace : ∑ i, A i i = 0) (e : S2) : scatter (fun u => c + linearMode b u + quadraticMode A u) e = c + (1 / 10 : Real) * quadraticMode A e

G12CFiniteChart.scatter_affine_traceless_quadratic_moments (c : Real) (b : Vec3) (A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) Real) (htrace : ∑ i, A i i = 0) (e : S2) : scatter (fun u => c + linearMode b u + quadraticMode A u) e = CAS12ScalarWrapper.moment 0 * c + CAS12ScalarWrapper.moment 1 * linearMode b e + CAS12ScalarWrapper.moment 2 * quadraticMode A e
allowed_support_lemmas: coordinate monomial moments up to total degree 4 from accepted CAS16 exact theorem
finite tensor second and fourth moment identities
reuse: CAS16C03.sphereMean and fullMonomialTheorem degree<=8; do not rerun or rewrite 165 cases
CAS12ConventionalRodrigues all-natural actual interval moment; consume n=0,1,2 in final corollary
No new assumption about missing canonical sphere measure equality or all-degree harmonic orthogonality

tool_roles.wolfram_xact: NOT_NEEDED for this bounded scalar finite polynomial unit; canonical sphere/frame bridge separately
tool_roles.sympy: Exact normalized degree-four chart moments checked by controller: 1, x=0, x²=1/3, x⁴=1/5, x²y²=1/15, z⁴=1/5; support only
tool_roles.lean: Actual source definitions, measure transport, finite action and moment-linked corollary

failure_policy: Before each compile snapshot exact executed source and capture separate stdout/stderr, argv/cwd/exit and import hashes; preserve first failure. After two same substantive failures, return exact goal for Astra/ultra read-only blocker review, then one bounded repair.
acceptance: All four exact theorem types compile from actual definitions with no sorry, hidden hypotheses or new axioms
Final axiom audit shows only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound or subset
Source-bound raw execution and import identities retained
Fresh independent Astra/ultra reviewer checks measure, normalization, finite-degree and all-ell boundary
